chapter: Bands, leaders and radio of the thirties and forties
title: Lee Wiley recording
summary: Kline mentions Morehouse recorded with singer Lee Wiley as a teenager; he does not remember the session.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I ran across somewhere - I'm afraid you are not going to remember but you made a recording with one of my favorite female singers.
I'm afraid you might remember it. Lee Wiley.
You do? You made a record with her.
Do you remember anything about it? She must have been a teenager.
Do you remember anything about her, about the recording session?
